_comment: Cards that exist only for the Case tests (tests/unit/keywords/test_cases.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_case` solves when its controller controls three or more creatures, and puts one 'Solved —' ability of every kind the gate has to reach after its 'To solve —' line: a trigger, an anthem, a player-wide static (read off the printed face by `player_statics`) and an activated ability.

cards.name: Test Case
cards.oracle_text:
To solve — You control three or more creatures. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
Solved — Whenever a creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
Solved — Creatures you control get +1/+1.
Solved — You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
Solved — {2}: You gain 2 life.

abilities.text: To solve — You control three or more creatures. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
Solved — Whenever a creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
Solved — You may play an additional land on each of your turns.
